newsitem.title: SPAIN: Spain police defuse Basque bomb after phone tip.
newsitem.headline: Spain police defuse Basque bomb after phone tip.

text.p: Police in Spain's Basque region defused a car bomb loaded with explosives and shrapnel on Tuesday, authorities said.

Officials in the northern town of Renteria were alerted by a telephone call to a local radio station in the name of the Basque separatist group ETA, which has carried out a wave of bombings and attacks in recent weeks.
The warning allowed police bomb experts sufficient time to defuse the device.
The car, packed with 30 kg (66 lbs) of explosives and 10 kg (22 lbs) of shrapnel, was parked in a narrow street with buildings nearby which had to be evacuated.
ETA has waged a 29-year violent campaign for an independent Basque region, and has killed some 800 people since 1968.
